<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <text x="20" y="27" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
  <line x1="325" y1="21" x2="325" y2="27" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="330" y1="18" x2="330" y2="27" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="335" y1="15" x2="335" y2="27" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="350" cy="22" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="350" y1="22" x2="356" y2="16" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="363" y="16" width="20" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="365" y="18" width="15" height="8" rx="1.5" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="384" y="19" width="2" height="6" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <line x1="25" y1="75" x2="36" y2="64" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2.2"/>
  <line x1="25" y1="75" x2="36" y2="86" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2.2"/>
  <line x1="25" y1="75" x2="48" y2="75" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2.2"/>
  <rect x="151" y="53" width="88" height="35" rx="5" fill="#F2C94C"/>
  <text x="195" y="77" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="23" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">IMDb</text>
  <line x1="20" y1="106" x2="370" y2="106" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Main content -->
  <text x="24" y="145" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Reset password</text>
  <text x="24" y="174" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">Create a new password to secure your IMDb account.</text>
  <text x="24" y="195" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">Use at least 8 characters with a mix of letters and numbers.</text>

  <!-- New password field -->
  <text x="24" y="232" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">New password</text>
  <rect x="22" y="242" width="346" height="52" rx="8" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
  <rect x="22" y="240" width="346" height="52" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="39" y="272" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">••••••••••</text>
  <ellipse cx="340" cy="266" rx="10" ry="7" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <circle cx="340" cy="266" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <line x1="332" y1="257" x2="348" y2="275" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Confirm field -->
  <text x="24" y="329" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Confirm new password</text>
  <rect x="22" y="339" width="346" height="52" rx="8" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
  <rect x="22" y="337" width="346" height="52" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="39" y="369" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">••••••••••</text>
  <ellipse cx="340" cy="363" rx="10" ry="7" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <circle cx="340" cy="363" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <line x1="332" y1="354" x2="348" y2="372" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Password guidance -->
  <rect x="24" y="416" width="14" height="14" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#40C173" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polyline points="27,423 30,426 35,420" fill="none" stroke="#40C173" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <text x="48" y="428" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">8 or more characters</text>
  <rect x="24" y="448" width="14" height="14" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#40C173" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polyline points="27,455 30,458 35,452" fill="none" stroke="#40C173" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <text x="48" y="460" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">A letter and a number</text>

  <!-- Strength bar -->
  <text x="24" y="495" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">Password strength</text>
  <rect x="24" y="504" width="342" height="6" rx="3" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
  <rect x="24" y="504" width="228" height="6" rx="3" fill="#F2C94C"/>
  <text x="262" y="511" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Good</text>

  <!-- Actions -->
  <g>
    <rect x="22" y="544" width="346" height="48" rx="8" fill="#000000" opacity="0.10"/>
    <rect x="22" y="542" width="346" height="48" rx="8" fill="#F2C94C"/>
    <text x="195" y="572" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#333333">Continue</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="22" y="606" width="346" height="48" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <text x="195" y="636" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#333333">Back</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Legal -->
  <text x="195" y="690" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">By continuing, you agree to our</text>
  <text x="195" y="712" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Terms of Use</text>
  <line x1="151" y1="715" x2="222" y2="715" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="195" y="733" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Privacy Policy</text>
  <line x1="151" y1="736" x2="239" y2="736" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="774" width="390" height="70" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="774" x2="390" y2="774" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Home -->
  <polygon points="39,799 49,790 59,799" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <rect x="42" y="798" width="14" height="12" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <text x="49" y="830" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Home</text>
  <!-- Search -->
  <circle cx="146" cy="798" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <line x1="152" y1="804" x2="158" y2="810" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <text x="146" y="830" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Search</text>
  <!-- Wishlist -->
  <circle cx="244" cy="797" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <polyline points="239,796 242,799 249,792" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <text x="244" y="830" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Wishlist</text>
  <!-- Profile -->
  <circle cx="341" cy="795" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <ellipse cx="341" cy="806" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <text x="341" y="830" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Profile</text>
</svg>
